name: Squid
subjectPrompt: One slender common squid, softly stippled mauve, russet and sandy pearl colors, elongated pointed mantle with a pair of triangular fins fused near its rear tip, compact head with one large visible eye, eight short flexible arms and exactly two noticeably longer slender feeding tentacles with modest club tips. One complete animal well inside the square. No water, bubbles, ink cloud, scene or other objects.

name: Tiny Viper Snake
subjectPrompt: One very small delicate dusty buff and pale gray viper, tiny sharp wedge head looking upward to the right, a minute dark line through the eye and muted warm ochre-brown chevrons. Body barely thicker than a finger. A single visibly uninterrupted diagonal S made of two simple wide curves, starting with a gently lifted head at upper right and ending with one pointed tapering tail at lower left. No crossings, dangling extra tips, branches, loose segments, rattles, props or rocks. Modest proportions, distinct warm pale coloration compared with a gray small viper.
